sources: the places or things from which something originates
Journalists must protect the identity of their sources.
these: used to refer to people or things nearby or just mentioned
These shoes are far more comfortable than my old ones.
challenges: plural of challenge; difficult tasks or problems that test ability
The new manager faces several challenges in her first month.
intensified: became or made greater in strength
Fighting intensified along the border after the ceasefire collapsed.
vulnerability: the quality of being easily harmed or attacked
That gap in the system is the real vulnerability.
regard: to consider or think of someone or something in a particular way
Many critics regard the film as a modern classic.
forest-based: relying on or originating from forest resources
Forest-based businesses provide income for many rural families.
initiatives: new plans or actions intended to solve a problem
The city launched several initiatives to reduce plastic waste.
tapari-making: the craft of making traditional leaf plates called tapari
Tapari-making provides income for several rural households in Nepal.
involving: including or concerning something as a necessary part
Police reported a crash involving three vehicles on the highway.
might: used to express possibility, especially a less certain one
It might rain later, so bring an umbrella just in case.
answers: responses given to questions or problems
The teacher collected the answers and began grading them that evening.
interconnected: linked together, each affecting the others
The city's transport system is highly interconnected by rail and bus.
social: relating to society or to spending time with other people
She enjoys an active social life with many close friends.
environmental: relating to the natural world or surrounding conditions
New environmental rules limit factory emissions near rivers.
turned: past tense of turn; changed direction or became something different
Both guesses turned out to be backwards.
their: belonging to or associated with the people or things just mentioned
The students left their bags in the classroom overnight.
means: A nod usually means agreement in most cultures.
livelihoods: means of earning enough to live
The drought threatened the livelihoods of thousands of farmers.
contributing: giving something, or helping to cause a result
Poor lighting was a contributing factor in the accident.
simultaneously: happening or done at the same time
The two teams launched their products simultaneously last week.
resilience: the ability to recover quickly from difficulty
khả năng phục hồi, sức bền bỉ
The community's resilience helped it recover quickly after the flood.
economic: relating to trade, industry, and the management of money
The government announced new economic reforms to boost growth.
